title: Orbital velocity expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be v = 2π(R+H)/T.

title: Moon mass expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be M = 4π²(R+H)³/(GT²).

title: Surface orbital velocity
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be v' = (2π(R+H)/T)√((R+H)/R) or an equivalent form.

title: Applying Newton's law
description: Important: The solution must correctly set centripetal force equal to gravitational force for parts (2) and (3).

title: Correct orbital radius
description: Important: The solution must use (R+H) as the orbital radius for Chang'e-1, not just R.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: The derivation shows clear algebraic steps to solve for the required quantities.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final expressions are dimensionally consistent.

title: Radius confusion error
description: Pitfall: Using the lunar radius R instead of (R+H) for Chang'e-1's orbit.

title: Formula misapplication
description: Pitfall: Using the surface gravity formula g=GM/R² incorrectly without centripetal acceleration for part (3).
